html:
Ninh Binh is not only famous for its limestone landscapes and rivers but also for its stunning lotus ponds that bloom beautifully during the summer months. From May to July, the region transforms into a peaceful paradise filled with soft pink lotus flowers, creating a romantic and photogenic atmosphere.

If you are planning to visit Ninh Binh during lotus season, here are the most beautiful places to enjoy and capture this unique natural beauty.

Hang Mua Lotus Pond

Hang Mua is one of the most popular lotus viewing spots in Ninh Binh. Located at the foot of Mua Mountain, the large lotus pond creates a picturesque setting surrounded by limestone cliffs.

During blooming season, the pond is covered with pink lotus flowers, offering a perfect foreground for the iconic mountain backdrop. Visitors can combine lotus viewing with climbing to the top of Hang Mua for panoramic views of Tam Coc.

Tam Coc Lotus Fields

Tam Coc is well-known for its scenic boat rides, but in summer, it becomes even more attractive thanks to its vast lotus fields.

As you glide along the Ngo Dong River, you will pass through areas filled with blooming lotus, creating a peaceful and immersive experience. The combination of water, mountains, and flowers makes this one of the most memorable sights in Ninh Binh.

Trang An Lotus Areas

Although Trang An is primarily known for its caves and river system, some areas also feature lotus ponds during the summer.

While not as concentrated as in Tam Coc or Hang Mua, the lotus here adds an extra layer of beauty to the already stunning landscape.

Van Long Nature Reserve

Van Long offers a quieter and more natural setting for lotus viewing. During the blooming season, lotus flowers appear across parts of the wetland, blending harmoniously with the calm water and limestone mountains.

This is an ideal location for travelers who prefer a peaceful and less crowded environment.

Thai Vi Temple Area

Near Tam Coc, the Thai Vi Temple area is surrounded by natural landscapes where lotus flowers bloom in small ponds and fields.

This location combines cultural and natural elements, offering a serene atmosphere for both sightseeing and photography.

Bich Dong Pagoda Surroundings

The area around Bich Dong Pagoda features small lotus ponds that enhance the tranquil and spiritual setting of the temple.

Visitors can enjoy a quiet walk, admire the flowers, and explore the pagoda nestled in the mountains.

Best Time to See Lotus in Ninh Binh

The lotus season typically lasts from May to July, with peak bloom occurring in June.

Early morning is the best time to visit, when the flowers are fully open and the light is soft, creating ideal conditions for photography.

Travel Tips for Lotus Season

Wear light and comfortable clothing suitable for summer weather.

Bring a hat, sunscreen, and water to stay protected from the sun.

Respect the flowers by avoiding stepping into lotus ponds or picking them.

Visit early in the day to avoid crowds and heat.
